metadata.name: Iron Maw
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A gigantic open-pit mine: six benches of rock spiral down round the excavation to the pit floor, where the bucket-wheel excavator works. Embers hold the motor pool on the north-west rim, Tide the workers’ camp on the north-east, with the ore crusher, screen house and mills between them joined by conveyor gantries. Drive the spiral haul road or the south-east switchbacks, ride the headframe and shaft lifts, climb the ladders at every bench end, or cut through the rock tunnels on the south rim and the west and deep benches. Built for 48 v 48.
